children.label: participatory_action_research
children.description: A methodology that involves community members in the research process to ensure that the evaluation reflects their needs and perspectives.

children.label: mixed_methods_evaluation
children.description: An approach that combines qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis methods to provide a comprehensive understanding of humanitarian interventions.

children.label: realist_evaluation
children.description: A methodology that seeks to understand how context influences the outcomes of humanitarian programs by exploring the mechanisms and contexts that lead to specific results.

children.label: outcome_harvesting
children.description: A methodology focused on identifying, documenting, and interpreting changes in behavior, relationships, actions, or policies that can be attributed to a humanitarian intervention.

children.label: systems_mapping
children.description: A methodology that uses visual and analytical tools to map the complex systems and interactions within a humanitarian context, helping to identify leverage points for effective intervention.
